steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.body: Clean, cut to bite-size pieces, and boil **2½ pounds potatoes** until tender, then cool.

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.body: Mix together: **½ cup mayonnaise**, **¼ cup sour cream**, **1 Tbsp vinegar** and **½ tsp salt & ¼ tsp pepper**.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Mix with potatoes, then add in as desired: **4 green onions**, chopped; celery; **blue cheese (3 oz)**; **crumbled bacon (about 5 slices)**; and **boiled eggs (2–3)**.
